action: Chase customers: check that transfers, bill payments and Zelle payments from November 16 went through once and only once, and contact the bank about anything missing or duplicated. No security action is needed.
exec: A software change at a major US bank disrupted payments at several banks for hours; a cyber cause was ruled out.
impact: More than 4,700 Chase customers had reported problems by 2 p.m. ET; some branch operations were affected.
plain: Chase customers had trouble with online banking and payments for several hours on November 16, which also affected some transactions at other banks. JPMorgan says a software release caused it and that it was not a cyberattack.
summary: Chase customers had trouble with online banking, transactions and Zelle payments for several hours on November 16, and it spilled over to transactions at other banks where Chase was a party. JPMorgan blames a software release that hit a subset of systems and says there is no evidence it is cyber-related; the FBI reported no sign of malicious activity. Wells Fargo separately cited technical issues; Bank of America says its systems ran normally. Cyber cause: ruled out.
title: JPMorgan Chase outage ripples to other major US banks

validation.note: Bank statement reported by many outlets; they describe the fault slightly differently (software bug vs hardware issue).
